_doc: Internal project-rates catalog. ADMIN-ONLY. NEVER exposed to public site, AI chat, customer portal, or tech mode. Used exclusively by the project_proposal quote builder for commercial / install / lighting / renovation / change-order line items. Per-customer negotiated rates (customer.negotiatedRates) override these defaults at quote creation and snapshot onto the quote (quote.customRates). Excluded from scripts/lint-no-hardcoded-prices.mjs by file extension (the lint scanner only walks root-level .html). NEVER copy these into pricing.json — pricing.json is the public catalog and must remain so. Brief 1 (May 2026). An item may carry an optional `detail` — a short spec line copied into the line item's description and shown under the component name in the generated proposal schedule (Proposal HTML, Jul 2026). `sprinkler_inclusion` zone rates mirror the Sprinkler System Builder's canonical new-install pricing (sitebuilder.html INSTALL_PRICING.perZone) — the site builder is the source of truth; keep this in step. The `water_source_*` options are price 0 because the water supply is already priced within the system/mainline — they add a descriptive schedule row, not a separate charge.
